mara.promptBlock: MARA ELLISON: 26, slim, warm light-olive skin, large hazel eyes, a small beauty mark beneath the outer corner of her left eye, long wavy chestnut-brown hair with a soft side part.

damian.promptBlock: DAMIAN CROSS: 34, broad-shouldered, medium-tan skin, deep-set steel-grey eyes, a thin pale scar through the left eyebrow, short black hair swept back, neat stubble.

julian.promptBlock: JULIAN VANCE: 28, fair skin, sandy-blond hair styled back, clear blue eyes, clean-shaven boyish face, gold signet ring on his right hand.

celeste.promptBlock: CELESTE HALE: 25, fair skin with freckles across the nose, sleek straight copper-red hair, green eyes, winged liner, glossy pink lips.

vivienne.promptBlock: VIVIENNE VANCE: 58, pale porcelain skin, silver-white chin-length bob, icy pale-blue eyes, high cheekbones, crimson lipstick, pearls.

theo.promptBlock: THEO PARK: 29, warm light-tan skin, short tousled black hair, round tortoiseshell glasses, dimpled grin.

chapel.promptBlock: SET: a grand old stone chapel at golden hour — tall pointed stained-glass windows throwing amber and rose light, warm dust in the sunbeams, a carved oak altar with ivory drapery, an aisle lined with white peonies and eucalyptus, wedding guests in the pews softly out of focus. Same building throughout: altar, aisle, and front pews.

car_interior.promptBlock: SET: the rear seat of a black luxury sedan at night, cream leather seats, a soft amber dome light, rain on the windows with gold and blue streetlights streaking past.

bakery_front.promptBlock: SET: the street front of a small old-fashioned corner bakery at night: dark green painted wood storefront, gold-leaf script above the window reading Ellison & Daughter, warm dim light inside, a white paper legal notice with a red stamp taped to the glass door (text not legible), wet cobblestone sidewalk reflecting an orange sodium streetlamp, three terracotta herb pots lined up beside the door.

penthouse_living.promptBlock: SET: a vast minimalist penthouse living room on a bright morning: floor-to-ceiling windows over a hazy city skyline, pale oak floors, a low charcoal sofa, a white marble kitchen island with a stainless espresso machine, cool soft daylight.

penthouse_study.promptBlock: SET: a private study in the penthouse at dusk: walls of leather-bound books, a heavy walnut desk with a green banker's lamp, a tall window with glittering city lights, and on a shelf a small silver frame whose photo is too far to read. Warm lamp pools against cool blue window light.

ballroom.promptBlock: SET: an opulent hotel ballroom at a black-tie charity gala: gilded columns, three huge crystal chandeliers, a sweeping white marble staircase, guests in evening wear holding champagne flutes (softly out of focus), warm gold light and flashes from press photographers.

terrace.promptBlock: SET: a moonlit stone terrace off the ballroom: wrought-iron railing, strings of warm lights, potted olive trees, the city skyline glittering below, cool blue night light with warm gold spilling from tall glass doors behind.

cellar.promptBlock: SET: the brick-vaulted cellar kitchen beneath the Ellison & Daughter bakery at night: a massive antique brick bread oven with a blackened iron door, wooden proofing racks, flour-dusted steel worktables, copper pans on hooks, a single caged bare bulb giving weak amber light, drifting dust, a narrow street-level window high on the back wall, a steep wooden stairway rising into darkness at the rear.

prompts.sceneVideo:
Animate the start frame. Keep faces, wardrobe, and set as they appear in the image. Motion and spoken lines only. Diegetic sound, no music, no narration, no extra characters.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in a fitted ivory lace wedding gown with a sweetheart neckline and chapel-length veil, hair in a low chignon, white peony bouquet. JULIAN in a charcoal tuxedo with a white rosebud boutonniere. Medium shot at the altar, eye level. MARA at frame left in her ivory gown and veil, peony bouquet trembling in both hands, face caught in dawning disbelief. JULIAN at frame right, chin lifted, cold and decisive. Golden stained-glass light on the veil, guests blurred behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Very slow push-in on Mara. Julian says, flat and cold: 'I can't marry you, Mara. I'm in love with Celeste.' Mara's bouquet trembles; barely audible, she whispers: 'She's my sister.' Soft gasps ripple from the pews as the organ note fades.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in her ivory lace wedding gown and chapel-length veil, low chignon, white peony bouquet. CELESTE in a fitted champagne satin maid-of-honor dress, copper hair straight and polished. Tight close-up on MARA's face, chin lifted, eyes glassy with tears that have not yet fallen, veil catching stained-glass light. CELESTE at frame right, slightly behind, a faint smirk. Shallow depth of field, Mara's eyes razor sharp.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in on Mara's face as a single tear slips free and she holds her chin high. Celeste smirks. Mara, voice cracking but steady: 'Three hundred people. And you chose now.'

scenes.imagePrompt: VIVIENNE in a dove-grey silk skirt suit with a strand of pearls, a black leather clutch, silver bob, crimson lipstick. Medium close-up of VIVIENNE in the front pew, side-lit by stained glass, glancing at a slim gold wristwatch with a small satisfied curl at the corner of her crimson lips; the altar softly blurred beyond her.
scenes.videoPrompt: Locked-off medium close-up. Vivienne glances at her gold watch, then toward the altar, and murmurs with quiet satisfaction: 'Right on schedule.' A slow, cold smile spreads across her crimson lips. Faint crowd murmur beneath.

scenes.imagePrompt: DAMIAN in a black tailored suit, crisp white shirt and slim black tie. Low-angle wide shot down the chapel aisle from behind the pews. Damian stands in the center of the aisle, jacket buttoned, expression calm and unreadable, guests' heads turned toward him. An unreadable figure in white at the far altar, too small to identify. Golden light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in from behind Damian as the whole chapel falls silent and heads turn toward him. In a low, steady voice: 'If the groom is finished, I'll marry her.' A wave of gasps. At the far end of the aisle, Mara slowly turns to look at him.

scenes.imagePrompt: DAMIAN in a black tailored suit, crisp white shirt and slim black tie. Side-tracking medium-wide shot of Damian in profile striding up the center aisle, jaw set, gaze fixed on the altar, guests' faces turning as he passes on both sides. An unreadable figure in white at the far altar. Golden light, floating dust.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lateral tracking shot alongside Damian in profile as he walks the length of the aisle, unhurried, guests turning to stare. Whispers ripple: 'Who is he?' 'Is he a guest?' Mara watches, breathless, at the altar ahead. Damian never breaks his gaze from her and stops at the altar steps.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in her ivory lace wedding gown, chapel-length veil, low chignon and white peony bouquet. DAMIAN in a black tailored suit, crisp white shirt and slim black tie. Close two-shot at the altar, both faces the same size: Mara's upturned wet eyes searching Damian's, golden backlight in her veil.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in over Damian's shoulder. Mara, whispering, searching his face: 'Who are you?' Damian, low and steady: 'Someone who doesn't leave.' After a long beat she places her trembling hand in his and he closes his fingers around it.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in her ivory lace wedding gown, chapel-length veil, low chignon and white peony bouquet. DAMIAN in a black tailored suit, crisp white shirt and slim black tie. Close two-shot at the altar: DAMIAN sliding a plain silver band onto MARA's ring finger; her eyes flick down to it in surprise, then up to his face. Blurred officiant's robes at the frame edge, golden light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close on joined hands as Damian slides a plain silver band onto Mara's ring finger; it fits perfectly. Mara looks from the ring up to his face, puzzled. An off-screen officiant asks: 'Damian Cross, do you take this woman?' Damian, eyes still on Mara: 'I do.' A ripple of shocked whispers at the name Cross.

scenes.imagePrompt: VIVIENNE in a dove-grey silk skirt suit with a strand of pearls, a black leather clutch, silver bob, crimson lipstick. Tight close-up on VIVIENNE, the smirk gone, color draining from her face, lips parted, knuckles white on the black clutch.
scenes.videoPrompt: Locked-off close-up. Vivienne's smile collapses; her hand tightens on the clutch. She whispers, barely voiced: 'Cross...' and her eyes dart toward the altar in alarm.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in her wrinkled ivory lace wedding gown, veil crumpled, chignon loosening, a faint mascara smudge, a plain silver band on her ring finger. DAMIAN in his black suit, white shirt and slim black tie. Medium two-shot across the back seat: MARA clutching her crumpled veil, mascara faintly smudged, staring hard at DAMIAN; he calmly extends a slim black folder toward her. Gold streetlight and rain streaks slide across the windows behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lateral drift across the rear seat as passing streetlights sweep gold across their faces. Mara, tense: 'Who are you?' Damian offers her the black folder: 'Your husband for one year. I clear the bakery's debt.' She looks at the folder, then at the ring on her hand.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in her wrinkled ivory lace wedding gown, veil crumpled, chignon loosening, a faint mascara smudge, a plain silver band on her ring finger. Close-up of Mara reading the contract under the amber dome light, brows drawn together, a disbelieving half-smile forming on her lips; the printed page soft in front of her with one line highlighted.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld-feel close-up. Mara's eyes race down the page and she lets out a short, incredulous laugh: 'Clause nine. No falling in love?' Damian, eyes on the rain-streaked window: 'I wrote it years ago.' Mara's smile fades as she looks at him.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in her ivory lace gown with Damian's black suit jacket over her shoulders, hair loosening, plain silver band. scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in from behind as Mara lays her palm against the glass beside the notice. Voice breaking: 'My father built this with his hands. Vance takes it Monday.' Damian steps up beside her, peels the notice off the door and tears it in two: 'Not anymore.'

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in her ivory lace gown with Damian's black suit jacket over her shoulders, hair loosening, plain silver band. scenes.videoPrompt: Damian bends, lifts the third flowerpot without searching, and holds up a small silver key. Mara stares, stunned, whispering: 'Nobody knows that key is there. How do you?' Damian turns the key over in his fingers and says nothing as rain begins to fall.

scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in on Mara's hands and face as she lifts the silver frame from the shelf. Her breath catches. She whispers: 'Dad?' Her thumb traces the older man's face; tears gather.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in an oversized cream cable-knit sweater and grey leggings, hair down, silver band. scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in an oversized cream cable-knit sweater and grey leggings, hair down, silver band. scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in an oversized cream cable-knit sweater and grey leggings, hair down, silver band. Close-up on Mara reading a handwritten letter under the green lamp, lips trembling, a tear falling onto the paper; the brass key glinting on the desk beside her hand.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in black jeans and a dark green wool coat over a cream sweater, hair in a loose side braid, silver band, flashlight in hand. scenes.videoPrompt: A floorboard creaks overhead; the shop bell rings faintly. The cellar bulb flickers and dies, leaving only Mara's shaking flashlight beam. Damian steps in front of her, whispering: 'Stay behind me.' Slow footsteps begin down the stairs.

episodes.title: You Told Me It Was an Accident

scenes.imagePrompt: VIVIENNE in a camel wool coat with a silk scarf, silver bob, crimson lips, black leather gloves. JULIAN in a black overcoat with an open collar, sandy-blond hair rain-damp and disheveled. Low-angle wide-medium shot from the cellar floor: VIVIENNE emerging from shadow at the foot of the stairs in her camel coat, silver bob immaculate, one black-gloved hand extended; JULIAN a step behind her, pale and rain-damp, eyes on the floor; the caged bulb swaying amber.
scenes.videoPrompt: The caged bulb sputters back to life. Vivienne steps out of the darkness at the foot of the stairs, Julian trailing behind her. Silky and calm: 'Hello, Mara. I believe you're holding something that belongs to my family.' Julian stares at the floor.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in black jeans and a dark green wool coat over a cream sweater, hair in a loose side braid, silver band, flashlight in hand. DAMIAN in a black wool overcoat over a charcoal sweater and black trousers. scenes.videoPrompt: Damian steps in front of Mara. Behind his shoulder, her hand slips into her coat pocket and her thumb presses the phone screen; a tiny red recording light glows. Mara, steady, stepping half into view: 'It belongs to my father.'

scenes.imagePrompt: VIVIENNE in a camel wool coat with a silk scarf, silver bob, crimson lips, black leather gloves. scenes.videoPrompt: Vivienne's mask slips. Icy: 'Your father wouldn't stay quiet, so I silenced him. Give me the ledger.' Beside her, Julian freezes, slowly turning his head toward her.

scenes.imagePrompt: VIVIENNE in a camel wool coat with a silk scarf, silver bob, crimson lips, black leather gloves. scenes.videoPrompt: Julian turns to his mother, voice cracking: 'You told me it was an accident.' Vivienne, not looking at him, colder than ever: 'Don't be sentimental, Julian.' Julian shakes his head and takes a step back.

scenes.imagePrompt: VIVIENNE in a camel wool coat with a silk scarf, silver bob, crimson lips, black leather gloves. scenes.videoPrompt: Red and blue light sweeps across the brick walls as sirens swell. Vivienne freezes. Julian steps away from her, hands open: 'I'm done, Mother.' Vivienne, appalled: 'Julian, don't you dare.'

scenes.imagePrompt: VIVIENNE in a camel wool coat with a silk scarf, silver bob, crimson lips, black leather gloves. Close-up on Vivienne, cornered and defiant, a brittle smile on her crimson lips, red-blue light flickering across her face, eyes flicking off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cornered, Vivienne laughs, brittle and cold, and looks past Julian at someone off-screen: 'You think I started this? Read the last page.' The sirens grow louder.

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in black jeans and a dark green wool coat over a cream sweater, hair in a loose side braid, silver band, flashlight in hand. DAMIAN in a black wool overcoat over a charcoal sweater and black trousers. Medium two-shot: Mara and Damian side by side, both faces readable, looking down at the ledger's final page under her flashlight; a bold ink signature at the bottom; red-blue light flickering on the brick walls.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara flips to the last page of the ledger as sirens wail above. Her eyes travel down to a bold signature at the bottom. She reads it aloud, hushed: 'Alistair Cross.' Beside her, Damian goes ghost-white: 'That's my grandfather.'

scenes.imagePrompt: MARA in black jeans and a dark green wool coat over a cream sweater, hair in a loose side braid, silver band, flashlight in hand. DAMIAN in a black wool overcoat over a charcoal sweater and black trousers. Tight two-shot: MARA stepping back from DAMIAN, eyes wide with hurt and suspicion, the silver ring visible on her trembling hand; DAMIAN reaching for her, stricken; red-blue light strobing across both faces.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara backs away from Damian, the ledger clutched to her chest, the silver ring trembling on her hand. Broken: 'Did you know?' Damian, stricken, reaching for her: 'Mara, I swear...' She shakes her head. The sirens peak; cut to black.
